answer.summary: You'll get a quiet home-base village hung beneath a cliff overhang. It has a big lantern-lit hall, four small hanging homes, a winch house, a lookout tower, a chain workshop and a ceiling garden, all in rustic timber and stone. Hanging lots aren't buildable yet, so the plan is written and waits. It needs a real overhang near your founding stone.
